description: Reviewed per-Index-file mappings from a character a Wikisource editor typed in place of a printed character (an editor's stand-in) to the printed character (F8b7, HeOCR/hocrgen#111). Applied after wikisource_plain_text conversion, where the context holds; the page keeps the faithful conversion's checksum (text_adjustments.converted_text_sha256) and records each mapping applied with its count. A mapping is admitted only for files where occurrences were checked on the page images; the survey of other stand-ins that were not mapped is in docs/wikisource_proofread_source.md.

rendered_from: {{!}} (the MediaWiki pipe magic word, which renders a plain |)
a | typed in the page body
files: The Seliḥot for the Entire Year.pdf
Seder Tefilot K'Minhag K.K. Sefaradim (Yosef Nachmuli, Korfu 1885).pdf
mappings.basis: In these three vocalised liturgical books every | the editors typed stands between two words of a verse at a Masoretic paseq or legarmeh position (for example Exodus 34:6, Daniel 9:19, Psalms 89:9, Psalms 137:7, Genesis 22:11, Deuteronomy 6:4), and the page shows a vertical stroke there. U+05C0 is the Hebrew character for that stroke; the ASCII vertical line is the keyboard stand-in.

mappings.method: Viewed the Commons 1920 px render of each listed page at the line holding the stand-in (located by aligning the page text to OCR line boxes, localisation only) and confirmed a printed vertical stroke between the two words; the other occurrences in the three files are at the same kind of verse position.
